rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's sixteen builder trees go (ficus and canary date palms along the back fences, a coral and a fan palm 3-3.6 m from the houses, jacarandas and corals by the seating); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the grill, two arbors, on the open lot corner, and one back yard.
